_README: Barcodes that appear on the Colne Stock Warnings export but are absent from the
Nelson Stock Levels report because Nelson does not range the line at all.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS: the nelson-coverage check in verify_build.py is a ratio of
matched barcodes to Colne warning rows. These lines can never match, so they drag
the ratio down permanently and every run was passing --allow-low-coverage to get
past it -- four builds running by 2026-08-19. A check that is waived every time is
not a check. Excluding them here makes the number mean 'rows we FAILED to match
for an unexplained reason', which is the thing actually worth alarming on.
Note the denominator effect that made the raw figure nearly meaningless: as picks
clear the warnings list the denominator shrinks while this set stays fixed, so
coverage FELL 94.9% -> 93.9% -> 93.2% across 18 Aug while the absolute number of
unmatched rows was flat or improving (17 -> 17 -> 16).
MAINTENANCE: verify_build.py hard-fails if any barcode listed here turns up in
NELSON_STOCK_MAP, i.e. Nelson has started stocking it -- remove it when that
happens. Do not add a barcode without first confirming it is genuinely absent from
the Nelson Stock Levels export; a broken export or truncated block looks identical
to a never-stocked line from the check's point of view, and burying a real failure
in here is worse than the waiver it replaces.
1000008588 'Fresh Take' was on the candidate list from the 15-18 Aug run logs and
was deliberately NOT added: it is present in the Nelson report as of 2026-08-19.

2026-08-19 16:27: the 7 character drinking bottles (8712645*) were REMOVED — Nelson took delivery and they now appear in the Nelson Stock Levels report (stock 6/3/2/1/2 and two at 0). The stale-entry guard caught this on its third run and hard-failed the build until the file was corrected, which is exactly the intended behaviour: left in, they would have been excluded from the coverage denominator forever and hidden 7 genuinely pickable lines from the check. Treat every entry here as provisional — ranging changes.
